items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I think it was a blessing to meet all these great people, you see. And he says who he was and so on and so forth. And I says, 'Oh, you're the man in the picture,' you know.

ctx.x: And so while I was asking him this question, Mr. Buddy Bradley happened to come by, and he says, he explained to me how you do a step, a certain step and some kind of tap strut, you know. And he had the Tack Annie in it, what they call Tack Annie.

And he taught me this step. By the way, Mr. Peg Leg Bass was in this show too. He was there. So it was just a fortune, you know. I think it was a blessing to meet all these great people, you see. And he says who he was and so on and so forth. And I says, "Oh, you're the man in the picture," you know. And he laughed. He liked children, see, Mr. Bradley, Buddy Bradley.
